[P3] Revisit the conditional cause-copying approach

CONTRIBUTING.md rule 2 requires considering simpler options and explaining why they do not work. Both formatters add a `cause !== undefined` branch, although `JSON.stringify` already omits undefined object properties. Including `cause` in the existing object construction would preserve the required behavior without these branches or the additional object copy here. The description does not discuss this option. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and document the simpler direction or why it is insufficient.
